title: Abstract methods a mod class does not write: the type, handled
text: The type `abstract method not written, game: linked` mostly held breaks the porter made up or that were always there: an intermediary id given to two methods renamed overrides wrongly; classes a jar carries for another loader were linked; methods the loader patches into defaults (the old class left them unwritten too) were counted; lambdas for a callback whose method changed linked silently. Each is handled generally, and callback lambdas move to the new signature as overrides do (a converted argument, or a default where the body never reads it).
finish: the type's finishes and mods counts fall across every update, port.jar-links.newest and big-updates up, and load on a real server and client where it frees the most
wrongIf: a mod this frees fails in a real game
result: Type finishes 102 -> 12 and appears in 316 -> 100 mod ports (875 -> 268 references). Every update 5,893 -> 5,972 of 9,423, big updates 1,904 -> 1,910, newest 15 -> 15. Five updates lower by named false links (Fabric builds listed for NeoForge, codec and HUD lambdas that would fail when called). Real NeoForge 1.21: every newly linked standalone mod loads on the server and in the client (33/36, 35/36; InventoryHUD+ as before).
